purpose: Development-only preregistration for a second continuation model that is scale-normalized, horizon-aware, OOD-conservative, and optimized only for incremental value over the already-frozen simple v1 controller. This protocol does not authorize use of any successful confirmation/disagreement split for fitting or retuning.

development_sources.status: failed confirmation formally retired for future development

excluded_from_training: all unrevealed agreement tails from C599
replay_requirement: The full 120-row development state table was not persisted in the prior compact result. Reconstruct it only by deterministic replay of the frozen search contract. Persist the reconstructed rows and hashes before fitting this protocol. Never infer missing rows from aggregate summaries.
decision_scope: The learned continuation policy is queried only at an index-65 state where the challenger has not exhausted, no verified challenger endpoint has beaten the retained incumbent, and the frozen v1 policy would stop. If v1 continues, exactly follow v1. The retained two-arm verified incumbent is never discarded.

target.binary_label: 1 iff exhaustive continuation after the v1-stop index-65 state yields a verified endpoint strictly better than the final endpoint returned by frozen v1; else 0
target.optimization_priority: incremental gain recovered over v1 per extra challenger compilation; raw P(any challenger gain over two-arm) is not the target

feature_guards.denominator_zero: Such a state is unsupported and falls back to v1; do not impute.
feature_guards.scope_note: remaining_candidates_in_stage65_over_n_nminus1 and prefix_fraction_of_n_nminus1 are specific to the relocation-search contract and are not universal theorem-proving features.

development_validation.rule: Fit scaler/model only on three development families and predict the held-out family. Concatenate OOF probabilities. No confirmation/disagreement data enter feature design, scaling, threshold selection, OOD bounds or model fitting.

threshold_selection: Among unique OOF probabilities, choose the largest threshold satisfying both positive-example recall >= 0.80 and gain-weighted recall >= 0.80. If none exists, mark this model specification failed; do not loosen thresholds post hoc. Ties choose the larger threshold.

ood_guard.definition: For a deployment decision, if any normalized raw feature lies outside the closed [min,max] range of that feature over all 120 replayed development states, abstain and return the frozen v1 action. This guard is deliberately conservative and cannot cause extra challenger spend.
ood_guard.authority: fallback only; OOD status can suppress learned continuation but can never force it

uncertainty_guard.decision: Point model must satisfy p>=threshold and at least 0.80 of valid bootstrap refits must also satisfy p>=threshold. If fewer than 150 valid two-class bootstrap refits exist, abstain to v1.
uncertainty_guard.note: This is a stability gate, not a calibrated confidence interval.

final_fit: After OOF threshold selection, refit the identical scaler+logistic on all replayed development states, freeze all feature definitions/scaler/model parameters/threshold/development min-max bounds/bootstrap procedure, and persist them before any wholly-new confirmation outcomes are revealed.
deployment_policy: Run frozen v1 first. At v1-stop index65 states only, apply feature support check, OOD guard, point probability and bootstrap vote. Continue the full challenger only if all gates pass; otherwise return v1. Any verified challenger improvement preserves the retained incumbent as fallback.
metrics: per-case no-harm vs frozen_v1 and two-arm
fraction of exhaustive incremental gain recovered
extra-compute fraction of exhaustive post-v1 tail
confirmation_rule: Any confirmation split must be wholly new and preregistered after the final model artifact is frozen. Do not reuse C594/C598/C599 or their agreement tails. A positive result requires strictly positive incremental verified gain over frozen v1 with zero per-case harm and a preregistered compute bound; aggregate success dominated by decisions already made by v1 is not evidence for the model.
formal_transfer_guard: This is synthetic positive-monotone graph 2-CNF ROBDD ordering only. Public Lean evidence motivates relative trajectory features and cost-quality allocation, not these numerical thresholds or feature formulas.
